description: From bedrock-q67.8 audit: (a) trims apply even while locked/recovering (Demux send path + pull opt before :not_ready rejection) — oldest_version can advance under the director between fact-gathering and recover_from, failing a recovery attempt (retry recovers; no data loss). Gate trim application on mode == :running. (b) durable_up_to > last_version is accepted; a buggy reporter can poison the trim point — reject or log (adjust the v100 test). See PR #93.

comments.text: From PR #93 second-pass audit: also (c) a non-binary durable_up_to crashes the log server via FunctionClauseError (let-it-crash acceptable for internal API, but validate when Demux wiring lands in q67.10); (d) contract now documented that reports must be actual commit versions the log holds — a gap-version report can trim past itself; enforce or keep trusting Demux.

title: Shale trim hardening: gate on mode==running; reject durable_up_to beyond last_version
